title: The Street Photographer Who Loved the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
summary: Alan Batt, 79, affectionately known as “Battman,” has published a book chronicling a decade of his city scenes.

title: Mamdani Wins Against Landlords in Rent Freeze Lawsuit
summary: A Manhattan judge handed a victory to Mayor Zohran Mamdani by dismissing a lawsuit filed by landlords over a rent freeze for rent-stabilized apartments.
caption: Mayor Zohran Mamdani’s campaign promise to “freeze the rent” for rent-stabilized tenants became a rallying cry for his supporters in 2025.

title: Union Leader Leaves M.T.A. Board After Holding Post from Florida
summary: Gov. Kathy Hochul had urged John Samuelsen, a transit workers union leader and one of her frequent critics, to resign. Mr. Samuelsen also has a home in Brooklyn.
caption: John Samuelsen, the international president of the Transport Workers Union, said the pressure for him to resign from the board of the Metropolitan Transportation Authority was “political headhunting.”
